notes.title: FLASH PARTY UPDATE ROADMAP (Fall/Winter 2024)
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43307144/64ff870fe50b56724938b2c0e084087d9c06660a.jpg

Greetings, Party Stars!

As the hot summer comes to an end, we bring you another wave of future update plans!

First up is the long-awaited new hero!

Flash Party will be welcoming a new hero, Tutu, after a long wait. She is a lively and curious young girl who loves to jump around. Rumor has it that her curiosity led her to the Metropolis for Flash Party because she heard that there were many different-looking people there. Tutu is an Assaulter hero, excelling at agile movement and attacks. Her "unique" body structure also brings about a unique fighting mechanic.

Tutu will make her debut in the Flash Party 4th Anniversary update in December, so let's look forward to her arrival!

The Tag Battle mode, which was teased in the Spring/Summer update, will be officially introduced with the SS7 in September. Tag Battle will be available as a permanent matchmaking mode, so get ready to develop new strategies for this mode!

In the SS7 mid-season update in October, we will bring about a battle mechanic update. All Power House heroes will gain a Power Reversal that can forcibly bounce the opponent away when attacked! To use the Power Reversal, you need to accumulate the energy by taking knock-out damage. When the energy is sufficient, immediately press the Attack or Special button when attacked to perform a Power Reversal!

Flash Party will celebrate its 4th anniversary in December, and this year's anniversary events will be as colorful as ever! We will also offer anniversary-exclusive badge sets and custom colorful stickers in the 4th Anniversary Exchange Shop. Additionally, during the 4th Anniversary celebration, we'll be hosting a special 7-day login event, where players can receive a classic skin for free each day they log in. Hurry and invite your friends to join Flash Party!

Lastly, we want to introduce another major plan for Flash Party - the Roguelike Mode.

Leveraging our continuous polishing of platform fighting game development, we've created another new and equally exciting action game in the world of Flash Party. This is a multiplayer Roguelike game, and we hope to bring a fast-paced, exhilarating, and Flash Party-themed gaming experience.

This mode is still under development, and more information and testing plans will be gradually revealed. This is a bold breakthrough for the Flash Party brand, as we hope to create a more diverse action game brand. Of course, we won't stop updating the platform fighting mode, and we will continue to release more content for the fighting mode in 2025!

 

We have also prepared a special redeem code for the release of this roadmap! Enter the code ROADMAP24FW in the game to claim 1 Aura Chest and 3 Astral Coins! (Valid until December 31st, 2024)

Thank you for the continued support and companionship from every Flash Party player! The party continues, and we'll see you on the broader stage!

Dear Party Stars,

It's been half a year since we launched the "Starwaves" version, and today we're back with another round of future update plans!

At the end of May, we will start Season SS5 - Dark Side of the Moon. Many new features will arrive in this version, and this season's update will be a major one! The Experimental Stickers we've been rolling out for the past two months will be officially implemented during the SS5 season. At the same time, we will also introduce a limited-time free hero feature, so that more players can experience the charm of our various party heroes. The sticker wishlist will be upgraded to what we call the "Wish Come True Card." During the subscription period, players can rent up to three colorful stickers and will have more ways to obtain the stickers. The Trophy Wall function will allow players who continue to support and participate in community events to accumulate more in-game achievements.

After the SS6 season, we still plan to launch a new Assist Mode— an easy-to-learn operation mode. Just click the party button, and the AI will help you with basic attacks and recovery operations. Even newcomers who have never played platform fighting games can quickly join the fun fighting party! Another feature in the works is a new 1v1 Tag Battle mode, which we hope will bring even more fun and intense competition.

In addition, we know everyone has been asking about when we will release new heroes. However, with the current limited development resources and evaluating the potential sales of new heroes based on the current player count, continuing to develop new heroes while maintaining a balanced profit and loss has become extremely challenging. Therefore, after careful consideration, we have made the difficult decision to temporarily suspend the release of new heroes.

This does not mean we will stop updating and launching new content. With the encouragement of exciting competitions in player communities around the world, we believe that the existing heroes of Flash Party can support a competitive combat environment. Our current development plan will focus on polishing and improving existing heroes, gradually adding features, and enhancing the experience while lowering the entry barrier to attract more players to join the fighting party.

We also look forward with hope that one day in the future, we will bring new characters to join the fight once again.

Once again, thank you to all the party stars for your continued support and company! The party goes on, and we'll see you in the arena!

notes.title: [Flash Party] Update Maintenance Patch Notes December 28th
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43307144/d7d7692f7425d17ed9549c1983e8bd2770209fe7.png

Hello everyone, "Flash Party" is scheduled for a server maintenance update from 08:00 to 11:00 AM on December 28th (Thursday), UTC+8. The specific update content includes:

[New Content]

[Starlight Relics: A New Skin Set]

Upon obtaining the Astral Greatsword, Gwynn's discovery became known to the world: remnants of the Creator God's celestial power endure within ruins strewn throughout the realm.
To seize this primeval strength, forces hidden in the shadows began to stir. Treasure hunters have started to scour the ruins, attempting to harness the remaining power for themselves.
And within the starlight, a guardian wielding a sacred sword was born. She will stand guard in the depths of the ruins, ensuring that every star continues to shine.

[ICEY's New Legendary Skin: Starlight Guardian]

She is a guardian born from the starlight, protecting the brightness of each cluster of stars.
ICEY's new legendary skin: Starlight Guardian, launches on December 28!

[More Skins Return to Party Stage]

The following limited-time skin events will make a return for a limited period!
The Journey of Souls Skin Set, including Sivi-Wolf Spirit, Lan-Golden Snake, and Tong-Demonic Fox, will return from December 28th to January 19th.
The Tales of Mountains and Seas Skin Set, including Mikko-Sarvainai the Holy Beast, Thanatos-Silhouette of Nine Li, and Tong-Warrior Saint of Mt. Pamir, will return from January 1st to January 29th before maintenance.
The Deep Sea Adventure Skin Set, including S-17-Deep Sea Weapon, Xiya-Azure Rhythm, and Tina-Tide Knight, will return from January 20th to February 9th.

[Pick-Your-Own Skin Pack]

Added a new skin pack for 6 Yuan / 0.99 USD / 160 Yen where you can pick one of the constantly available RARE or RECOLOR skins to purchase. This item will be available in the shop for a limited time after January 20th.

[Battle Adjustments]

Term examples:A: AttackB: Skill (Star key)N-Series Attack: An attack performed without inputting any directionForward throw/backward throw: Forward or backward grabs and throwsInvincibility: Can be attacked but will not suffer damage or negative effectsHit stun: Uncontrollable, unable to perform other actions

[Sivi]
Objective:
Enhance the practicality of certain stickers and optimize combat mechanics cues in battles.
Adjustments:
Up B: Slightly delay the timing of consuming the "Down B" energy overload charge gauge during the Up B action, so that when Up B is interrupted without a noticeable start-up lag, it doesn't deplete the charge gauge.
Colorful Sticker [Shockwave Suction]: Significantly increase the wind force applied to nearby targets and can pull ground targets away from platforms.
Colorful Sticker [Super Overload]: When carrying Super Overload, the charge gauge will have scale marks as a cue. When the charge reaches the first segment, the charge gauge will be highlighted.

[Heracles]
Objective:
Modify sticker design to enhance usability.
Adjustments:
Colorful Sticker [Thunderclap]: Change the sticker effect so that after carrying the sticker, the Side B and the comet hit by Side B's Neutral B no longer cause paralysis and slightly reduce the direct damage caused; however, it will call down a bolt after a short interval to inflict secondary damage on the hit target.
Bug fixes:
Colorful Sticker [Warrior Fury]: Fixed the issue where pressing the shield button while crouching could not be used to prematurely end the Fury burst.

[Sandy]
Objective:
To increase the ease of use of moves and improve the practicality of certain stickers.
Adjustments:
Side B: An additional attack hitbox is added close to the character during the start-up of Side B, knocking the opponent to the second hitbox's location, decreasing the chances of going through targets at close range.
Colorful Sticker [Iron Bash]: When equipped with the sticker, using Charged Attack will directly trigger Iron Bash without the need for additional charging time.

[Mr. 5]
Objective:
To improve the practicality of certain stickers.
Adjustments:
Colorful Sticker [Power Mortar]: When equipped with the sticker, using Charged Attack will immediately fire a long-range mortar without the need for additional charging time.

[Kamiki Yuri]
Objective:
To improve the practicality of certain stickers.
Adjustments:
Colorful Sticker [Let It Spin]: When equipped with the sticker, using Charged Attack will immediately activate Let It Spin without the need for additional charging time, and slightly increase the knock-out power and the duration of the attack hitbox (the duration of the move itself is not extended).

[Seaya]
Objective:
To prevent infinite combo situations and enhance the practicality of certain moves and stickers.
Adjustments:
Up Aerial: If Up Aerial doesn't hit with its final hitbox before landing, it will cause an additional knock-out to targets above, based on the opponent's damage percentage.
Down B: Slightly faster start-up of the reflection hitbox for Down B.
Colorful Sticker [Rhythmic Notes]: Upon successful reflection, adds the effect of "increasing Showtime energy meter," and with a full energy meter, Down B additionally has more health recovery and energy increase.

[Thanatos]
Objective:
Enhance the utility of certain moves and Stickers.
Adjustments:
Down B: Reduced the start-up time for Down B, and when Down B is used in the air, it will now inherit some of the horizontal velocity instead of immediately dropping to zero.
Colorful Sticker [Fearless Glaive]: Modified Sticker effect to enhance the performance of Neutral B Glaive when carrying the Sticker, increasing its flight speed, range, and damage.

[Tarara]
Objective:
Enhance the utility of certain Stickers.
Adjustments:
Colorful Sticker [Hammer Mastery]: Increased the speed and distance that can be moved forward when using Down B with the Sticker. Fixed an issue where hitting a shield with Down B while carrying the Sticker allowed immediate action.

[Gwynn]
Objective:
Enhance the utility of certain Stickers.
Adjustments:
Colorful Sticker [Gravity Field]: Enemies within the Gravity Field will also experience an additional effect of ground speed decay.

[Other Bug Fixes]
Fixed an issue where certain Hero Training Ground AI demos could not be completed.
Fixed a bug where Alice using Down B at the edges of the blast zone could potentially freeze the game.
Fixed an issue in the Anniversary Event where specific missions could cause errors in the gameplay mode.
Fixed incorrect text descriptions for some of Kamiki Yuri's Badges.
Fixed a problem on the Deep Sea Dancing map where characters could get stuck in certain areas at the bottom of the map.
Fixed an issue on the PC version where ICEY could not be selected in Local Versus mode.Fixed an issue where the Chilli Ancient Tribe skin's lobby animation did not display on some devices.Fixed an issue with Tina's Valkyrie skin where the lobby animation lacked some effects.Optimized the Cupid Squirrel Cub skin by improving the visual cues for the explosion radius effect when triggering clouds with musical notes.

Lastly, please download the latest game client from the app store after the update and maintenance are complete. After the update, we will present 3 Star Chests as gifts (valid for 30 days). Please check your email for the gift.

Greetings, Party Stars! We are carrying out a Scheduled Maintenance for Flash Party on Tuesday, November 28th, from 08:00 AM to 11:00 AM (UTC+8), during which the service will be temporarily unavailable. Here are the details of the update:

[New Content]

[Third Anniversary]

The Flash Party is set to celebrate its third anniversary!
Participate in daily missions to exchange your choice of colorful stickers, Aura Chest, Astral Coin, sticker fragments, and the third anniversary commemorative name card set. The party never stops, and the joy never ends!

[New Party Pass: Forever Party]

New season: Forever Party and the new Party Pass are coming soon!
Purchase the Party Pass and get the Magician: Dark Talon. Complete party missions, continuously unlock a wealth of resources and various outfits, and reach level 30 to get the Kamiki Yuri Starwaves skin: Starry Dance. The valuable rewards are not to be missed!

[SS2 Arena Exclusive Skin: Tina Valkyrie]

Her unrivaled prestige will ultimately be left on the battlefield - Tina!
Reach a level 20 intensity in the new season's arena, and you'll receive the SS2 Arena Exclusive Skin, Tina: Valkyrie!

[New Map: Deep Sea Dance]

Welcome to Seaya's hometown - Atlantis!
This city, combining ancient technology and romantic art, possesses the precious magno stone energy. Therefore, it has attracted envy and robbery, and amidst the turmoil of war, Atlantis sank to the bottom of the sea.
After Seaya left and shined in the Metropolis, a clash between old and new erupted in this mysterious underwater city. The council, fearing the power of magno stones would cause trouble again, coerced the queen into ordering the recall of her daughter and forbade anyone from leaving Atlantis, prompting an imminent civil war.
The Deep Sea Adventure unfolds, and Seaya, returning to her hometown, successfully resolves the crisis with everyone's help. After long and almost sleepy discussions, the council finally decides: Open up Atlantis and join the party stage!
The hustle of tourists and the excitement of players will bring unprecedented peace and vitality to this city.
The new map: Deep Sea Dance, will open on November 28th!

[New Map: Sky Duel]

The battle stage returns to the rooftop of Center School once again!
New Map: Sky Duel, opening on November 28th!

[More Skins Return to Party Stage]

The following limited-time skin events are making a comeback!
The Snow Reverie Skin Set lottery event, featuring Seaya - Song of Snow, Cupid - Music Man, and Magician - Gift Courier, will make a return from November 28 to December 27.
The Tribe Carnival Skin Set, which includes Cupid - Squirrel Cub, Macalon - Tribe Leader, Chilli - Ancient Tribe, and Heracles - Psychic Shaman, will be back in the store for sale on December 8, with a limited-time discount available until December 29.
The Vernal Ode Skin Set lottery event, featuring Alice - The Little Gardener and Foxx - Primavera Painter, will return from December 8 to December 31.
The RoboT-Rex VX-001 skin lottery event for Macalon will be back from December 22 to January 11, 2024.

[Adjustments]

Rematch Function Optimization
The reminder for the "Rematch" function has been optimized. Now you can see if your opponent has clicked on "Rematch" and is waiting.
The Stardust Shop now stocks the brand new [BO3] emoji set. If you want to invite your opponent to a rematch, send them an emoji!Season Merchandise Adjustment└Kamiki Yuri - Alter Verse College Girl and Tina - Alter Verse College Girl will be added to the Alter Crystal Exchange Shop. In the Alter Crystal Exchange Shop, the number of
Colorful sticker chests that can be exchanged each season has been adjusted from 1 to 3.
The main lobby and background music for Season 6 - Legends Season have been added to the Stardust Shop.Other Product Adjustments
The Weekly Aura Supply pack in the shop will be adjusted from once a week to three times a week starting from December 4th.Players with Monthly Pass can purchase it at a discounted price.

[Battle Adjustments]

Terminological examples:
A: Attack
B: Skill (Star key)
N-Series Attack: An attack performed without inputting any direction
Forward throw/backward throw: Forward or backward grabs and throws
Invincibility: Can be attacked but will not suffer damage or negative effects
Hit stun: Uncontrollable, unable to perform other actions

[Overall Adjustments]

Normal Sticker that gives damage bonuses can now affect the attacks made by Hero's summoned creatures and companions.
Example: Derek's Grenade and Sandy's Bandy attack can be enhanced by the skill attack bonus. The charged attack of the upgraded Tarara is enhanced by the charged attack bonus, etc.
The attacks made by the Hero's summoned creatures and companions can now also normally trigger the Knock-out Score recovery effect of the Rebirth Sticker.

[Heracles]

Objective:
To improve the stability of rage and standardize the technique mechanism.
Adjustments:
Passive skill "Rage": Slightly adjusted the rage attack judgement and size to prevent inability to hit when in close range with opponents.
Neutral attack: The window for linking the ground neutral attack 2 to the up/down attacks has been adjusted to be consistent with the window for linking to ground neutral attack 3. This standardizes the linking rules for ground neutral attack 2 to up/down attacks in both sliding mode and classic input mode.
Down attack: The possible actions linked after the ending recovery have been adjusted to be all ground actions (originally, only ground movement can be linked).
Dash attack: The possible actions linked after the ending recovery have been adjusted to be all ground actions (originally, only ground movement and attack can be linked).
Down B: The possible actions linked after the ending recovery have been adjusted to be all aerial/ground actions (originally, skills cannot be linked).
Neutral B: The possible actions linked after the ending recovery have been adjusted to be all aerial/ground actions (originally, only ground movements can be linked).

[Cupid]

Goal:
Make certain moves easier to use by improving their visual cues
Updates:
Colorful Sticker [Lingering Music]: After the ground attack, forward aerial, and back aerial charged attacks are complete, there will be a flashing effect above Cupid's head.
Up attack note: The hit effect of notes exploding after they hit the ground has been added, increasing the effect display but not altering the move performance.
All yellow notes: All yellow notes (including ground attack, up attack, and enhanced attacks with the colorful sticker) will no longer be destroyed after hitting the opponent, they can now penetrate the opponent.
Down B: During the floating period, holding the joystick downward will immediately interrupt the floating.

[Alice]

Goal:
Enhance neutral game ability and usability of certain moves
Updates:
Down attack: Adjusted the knock-out angle and knock-out strength of the down attack to make the knock-out more horizontally oriented and reduced the ending recovery.
Back aerial: Reduced the ending recovery of the move.
Neutral B: During B reversal (instantly pushing the joystick in the opposite direction after the start of the move) the move can have a reverse acceleration.

[Derek]

Goal:
Make moves easier to use
Updates:
Up attack: Slightly shortened the start-up of the first phase of the up attack and increased the sweet spot size. Adjusted the knock-out strength and angle of the first phase enabling the move to hit close opponents to the sweet spot of the second phase.
Up B: Adjusted the ledge grab detection of Up B to reduce exposure.
Bug Fixes:
Aerial: Fixed a bug where the move freezes at the end of a landfall action after an aerial attack.
Edge fall: Fixed a bug where the player was sometimes unable to fall off the platform when edge fall was triggered.

[Lan]

Goal:
Improve the performance of certain moves
Updates:
Back aerial: Adjusted the knock-out strength and angle to make the target fly upwards. Reduced the ending recovery of the move and the trigger window after landing, making the move more connective to other moves.
Up aerial: Greatly moved up the timing for a fast fall.
Neutral B: Reduced the ending recovery.
Down B: When there is a Wind Bell on the field, using "Down B" again will destroy the existing Wind Bell and recreat a new one.

[Gwynn]

Goal:
Improve the performance of certain moves
Updates:
Down B: Slightly increased the grab range (also increased the visual range) and optimized some potential misoperation problems. Now, after successfully hitting an opponent with a ground Down B, early input of jump during the ending recovery will use ground jump, no longer consuming an aerial jump.
Up aerial: Slightly increased the attack size.
Ground neutral attack: Adjusted the pre-input mechanism of a ground neutral attack to prevent misoperation of a neutral attack when pre-inputting other ground attacks.

[Tina]

Bug Fixes:
Adjusted the collision range when using shield to avoid a few rare cases where the opponent couldn't be grabbed due to being pushed away.

[Chilli]

Bug Fixes:
The hit of the charged attack that pulls the opponent to the front can no longer be teched.

[S-17]

Bug Fixes:
Edge fall: Fixed a bug where the player was sometimes unable to fall off the platform when edge fall was triggered.

[ICEY]

Goal:
Improve move stability
Updates:
Down B: Slightly adjusted the knock-out force of the second stage attack, reducing the inability to knock opponents to the third stage attack position when performing close combat.

[Other Bug Fixes]

Fixed issues where some hero tutorial AI demonstrations failed.
Adjusted the size of some emojis to standardize the size of emojis in the game.
Fixed some issues that may occur during the resource download during the initial installation of the Google Play version.
Fixed an issue where incorrect skin options appeared in Local Versus mode on the PC version.
Fixed a display issue in the Season 5 lobby scene.

Lastly, please download the latest game client from the app store after the update and maintenance are complete. After the update, we will present 3 Star Chests as gifts (valid for 30 days). Please check your email for the gift.

[Heracles New Legendary Skin: Dragon Slayer]

Greetings, Party Stars! We are carrying out a Scheduled Maintenance for Flash Party on September 27th (Wednesday) from 08:00 to 11:00 (UTC+8), during which the service will be temporarily unavailable. Here are the details of the update:

[New Content]

[New All-rounder Hero: ICEY]

The collaboration between Flash Party and the indie action game ICEY is officially launched!
Time starts to flow again, and ICEY embarks on a journey to find herself once more. This time, she arrives in Metropolis. Pummel, cyclone, overload... those familiar skills will be on display on the party stage!

[Starwaves - Major Version Update]

Flash Party welcomes another major update, including many adjustments, hoping more players can enjoy the fun of Flash Party!

The main content of this update includes:
- Removal of Hero Level system
- Added battle mechanics: Edge Fall, Jablock, Pushback Influence
- Added three new maps
- Matchmaking Mode changed from following time map rotation to random map selection
- 1v1 mode and peak arena add rematch function, allowing up to BO3 matches
- New Hero proficiency system, improving proficiency unlocks various rewards
- Added Stardust appearance shop, with past Season lobby, BGM, loading Background, arena Skin, etc. returning gradually

New Season: Starwaves and new Party Pass coming soon! We will launch the new SS series after this update and reset the Season !

[SS1 Arena Exclusive Skin: Sivi Gladiator]
The horn of SS1 has been blown, and the gladiator is about to take the stage.

Greetings, Party Stars! We are carrying out a Scheduled Maintenance for Flash Party on Thursday, July 27th, from 08:00 AM to 11:00 AM (UTC+8), during which the service will be temporarily unavailable. Here are the details of the update:

[New Content]

[New Power House Hero: Gwynn]

In the tales passed down through generations among the treasure hunters, lies a mysterious treasure buried deep underground - the Astral Greatsword. It is said that the sword is left by the God, stretching a thousand miles long and weighing ten thousand pounds. Only the strongest, sturdiest, and most powerful being in the universe can wield this sacred greatsword.

So when Gwynn found the bare hilt of the Astral Greatsword along with the gravity gloves that control it, both she and the sword were utterly bewildered.

In order to prove its might to this small-sized adventurer, the Astral Greatsword led Gwynn towards relics one after another, seeking its broken sword fragments. The adventures that unfolded, filled with peril and wonder, spanned twelve volumes of Gwynn's exploration diary.

"…Hey, Gwynn, even if you can't find the last fragment, I will accept you as my new master," the Astral Greatsword shyly said before they delved into the depths of the ocean, looking for the ancient ruins of Atlantis.

"I don't want to be your master."

Then, before the Astral Greatsword could get angry, Gwynn blinked her eyes:

"—We are the best adventure partners!"

Gwynn is a brand-new Power House Hero, and the seamless bond forged with the Astral Greatsword during their adventures allows this seemingly small girl to skillfully command the greatsword on her back, unleashing wide-ranging attacks. As a Power House Hero, Gwynn's up special and side special moves both have significant area damage and excellent KO potential. Her neutral special can summon meteorites to attack targets and with a Colorful Sticker equipped, she can also shatter ground-based meteorites, causing explosions. Gwynn's down special is a close-range grab amd throw, and is able to unleashes a gravity black hole attack after a successful grab. When equipped with a Sticker, this ability also generates a gravity field that restricts the gravity of everyone within it, making Gwynn's massive sword assault even more terrifying.

To help the Astral Greatsword return to its former glory, Gwynn set out on her next adventure, aiming for the God's party stage. Let's embark together, with a new adventure waiting ahead!

(Maybe the Astral Greatsword has already regained its original form, but just too shy to admit it?)

[New Party Pass: School Ghost Stories]

New Season: School Ghost Stories and the brand new Party Pass are coming soon!

Purchase the Party Pass to instantly unlock Lan: Night Watcher. Complete party missions to continually unlock a massive amount of resources and various costumes. Reach Level 30 to obtain Sophia Alter Verse Skin: Meow JK. Don't miss these amazing rewards!

[New Feature: Friendly Battle Tournament Room]

You can now create an 8-player single-elimination tournament room directly in Friendly Battle, inviting friends or recruiting players from the world channel to join. Anyone can host a fighting competition anytime, anywhere! Tournament rooms support both 1v1 and Team Relay modes, as well as full BO1 and BO3 for semifinals, and BO5 for finals. Let's heat up the party matches!

[New Feature: Replay Theater]

Introducing the Replay Theater feature – all players can now directly review in-game match replays here! In addition to scrolling through recommended high Rank exciting matches, the Replay Theater also supports customized searches based on Rank, character, and player ID. If you want to improve your combat skills by studying replays, this feature will be a great help!

*Replay Theater offers a privacy switch for players to decide whether to share their match replays in the theater.

[New Feature: Match ID Sharing and Replay]

In addition to the Replay Theater feature, we also support sharing and replaying specific matches. Each match can be shared using its match ID, and other players can enter your match ID in the game to directly watch the corresponding replay. Share your exciting matches and discuss with your fellow community members!

[New Skin Set: Deep Sea Adventure]

Atlantis... a deep-sea pearl hided under the boundless ocean, a mysterious city known by few. Scholars have found records in Metropolis library about Atlantis's past: "Coveting... magno stone... war breaks out... Atlantis... sinks into the depths... vanishes."

However, only a handful of people know that after the fall of Atlantis, the survivors used the energy from the magno stone to rebuild a vast underwater city. This city, with its ancient legends and powerful technology, has been thriving under the rule of the queen of Atlantis for generations - until Seaya's departure.

The princess left Atlantis and shined on the stage in Metropolis, causing a shock to the mysterious city hidden in the depths. The council worried that if the power of the magno stone became known again, it would attract evil races eager for power. They coerced the queen to recall Seaya before Atlantis was discovered by the outside world and ordered the queen to forbid anyone from leaving Atlantis without permission.

The queen and the council had a fierce conflict, until one day, a warning horn sounded, breaking the longstanding tranquility.

Meanwhile, in Metropolis, Seaya's crystal necklace, given by her mother, started flashing like a warning and a call...

Atlantis, her azure homeland... Seaya clenched the crystal, knowing it was time to return home.

Seaya originally intended to say goodbye to everyone, but after fully understanding the perils of this journey, S-17 asked the old tinker to retrofit its armor for underwater operations, hoping to accompany Seaya to Atlantis.

The ultimate weapon armor, resembling a sea beast, is said to have been inspired by a dazzling and colorful fish that Cookie caught - it even provided some materials! Apart from the stunning design, it also features Cookie's self-created "Meow Mirage Cannon" - originally meant for building demolition in Metropolis.

notes.title: Flash Party Update Roadmap 2023.4-7
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43307144/2fd855480c9d807206126064cd7a9facbee77fe3.png

Hello, Party Stars!

Today, we would like to share the update roadmap of Flash Party for the next 4 months with you. During this period, we will focus on optimizing and enhancing the basic experience of our game, and providing more features that cater to the preferences of fighting game players.

[April]

Firstly, in April, Flash Party will launch its 22nd hero. Through the current in-game Warm-Up event, you can find some clues about this hero and their background story. They will be an Assaulter hero with great combo ability and will be officially announced on April 26th!

At the same time, in April, a new mode called Competitive Tag Team Match will be added to Friendly Battle. In this mode, there are no strikers or any Buffs, so both sides will have a fair 3v3 duel.

Moreover, we have made some new optimizations to the controller:

We will allow players to customize the response area of the left joystick, which will improve the problem of mis-input.

The joystick will also support multi-button operations. After this change goes online, the button input of the joystick will be smoother. For example, you can directly use grab while holding down the shield button. Currently, a fast jump+attack may be misjudged as a double jump, but with this change, such problems caused by fast input can also be solved.

Of course, we will continue to optimize the controller settings for better performance in the future, and we look forward to your feedback after the update!

[May]

May marks the beginning of the new season 10, and there will be new arena rewards and Party Pass content.

We will also make significant updates to the new Training Ground, including many customizable options. In the new version, the AI will be able to reset position and perform auto recovery with one click. You will be able to set the KO score and some other options in the training mode. Players who want to practice combos should definitely try it out!

The Dojo system introduced in March is just the beginning. In May, the Dojo will add more missions and rewards. At the same time, it will also be more convenient to invite players from the same Dojo in 2v2 and friendly battles. What kind of new features do you want to have in your Dojo?

[June]

The June update will mainly focus on new modes in friendly battles.

In the Fighting Ring mode, players will take turns to replace the defeated one and compete for the final champion.

In the Tournament mode, players can hold self-organized tournaments in friendly battles and invite their friends to join the game. The brackets will be updated automatically.

[July]

Apart from the new season, there will be a brand-new Power House hero in July. You can guess who it is based on the picture in the roadmap...

Also, the battle replay system will be further optimized. Excellent matches will be pushed to the FPTV lobby for all players to watch. You can also generate a battle replay for your own match and share it with others by entering the corresponding replay ID.

That's all for the detailed explanation of this update roadmap. If you have any suggestions or ideas, feel free to leave a comment below. We will regularly share the update roadmap of Flash Party with you in the future. Thank you for your support of the game!

notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43307144/cd584f0503978a8f59e70199aed3a260c8c2d6d5.jpg

Hello Party Stars! Flash Party is scheduled to be under maintenance from 10th January 08:00 AM to 12:00 NOON (UTC+8). The detailed update contents are as follows:

[New Content]
________________________________________

[Major Version Update 1.0: Stardust Warriors]
At last, the much-anticipated Major Version Update "Stardust Warriors" is here!
We have a bunch of exciting content: New Heroes, Universal Mechanism, Sticker Mechanism, BR Mode, New Season, and various New Skins... Turning the page for this multi-platform next-gen platform fighter!

[New Hero: Cookie & Can]
Old Tinker’s kitten, Cookie, is a super rare male calico cat. It’s said that they were born in 1/400000 chance and are considered a symbol of luck. Grandpa Tinker is an incredibly talented handyman. Not only did he create S-17, but he also constructed Cookie's exclusive fighting Mech, "Can," which drastically improved Cookie's combat capabilities in the party arena.
However, Grandpa was unaware of Cookie’s true motivation for attending the Flash Party: The kitty wants to conquer the universe!Can he fulfill his dream?
Cookie is an Impeder Hero bolstered by the unique "Strengthens Grab & Throw" passive skill; his Skill combination has almost unmatched hampering ability in mid to long range. Cookie's Side Special is his primary Footsie skill, which covers a vast area in front of the Hero with an adjustable launching angle.
In addition to the mentioned characteristics, Cookie has a most distinctive multi-leveled Charged Cannon at his disposal while controlling Can. While the initial shot has a shorter range, medium firing rate, and lower damage, Can’s Charged Cannon can continue to charge up to 4-tiers. The Cannon fires accelerated shells delivering devastating damage at its maximum energy capacity. Of course, firing the Cannon’s fully-charged shot will cause Can to be “overloaded” and receive additional damage.
The charging mechanism of Can is highly flexible. At any point during the Charging process, you can lift the charge and resume charging whenever necessary. You can fire the Charged Cannon immediately at any charging stage to impede or finish off your opponent, depending on your quick decision-making under changing circumstances.

[Hero’s Universal Mechanism]
The major update “Stardust Warriors” introduces the revolutionary “Hero Style Enhancement,” categorizing Heroes into four distinct types: Assaulter, Impeder, Power House, and All-rounder. Heroes are assigned corresponding Universal Mechanisms according to their type, adding more variety to their gameplay.
The Assaulter Heroes can cancel an action after landing a specific attack; the Impeder Heroes strengthen the next Grab & Throw after hitting the shield a certain number of times; Power House Heroes increase damage according to their current KO Score; and All-rounder Heroes charge three directional gauges - Up/Mid/Down - with attacks of corresponding directions, and when all three are full, they can unleash a more powerful Super Neutral Special, which starts the charging process over again after release.

[New Sticker System]
The "Stardust Warriors" update has increased the maximum Hero Level to Lv.10. Sticker as a replacement Skill will be adjusted to Normal Stickers and Colorful Stickers. Generic sticker slots are unlocked as the Level escalates, providing various ability boosts for heroes, such as Weight increase, Special Damage increase, Movement Speed increase, Damage to Shields increase, etc.
Also, Colorful Stickers slots will be unlocked for Heroes at Levels 7 and 10, respectively. Heroes will have 4 Colorful Stickers that grant Heroes various passive Skills without altering their original Skill, allowing for a range of diverse play styles.

[New Skin Set: Tales of Mountains and Seas]
Legend has it that the Pamir, a crescent-shaped mountain range, lies at the edge of the desert beyond the Northwest Ocean. This most sacred mountain holds immense divine power. Therefore, the past Warrior Saints safeguarded the gate to the holy mountain, dispelling the evil.
To become a Warrior Saint, one must possess exceptional martial prowess and moral character. Only a few chosen by the Rain Dragon have the power to transform into the spirit dragon and overcome insurmountable challenges.
In the distant Orient, the leader of Nine Li plotted to terrorize the Central Plains with his giant scythe and powerful Spells, determined to dominate the world. Wherever the Nine Li Overlord went, thunder and lightning turned people's lives into misery and suffering. No tribe could withstand his violent invasion, and they were forced to retreat to the foot of Mount Pamir as their last stand. The chaos of battle would soon consume the peace that had endured for thousands of years.
At the pivotal instant, the Warrior Saint of Mt. Pamir transformed into the spirit dragon and conjured the Holy Beast: Sarvainai, to defeat the Silhouette of Nine Li together.
Who will prevail in this momentous battle? Amidst the Mountains and Seas, the legend continues...
New Skin Set: Tales of Mountains and Seas will be available starting January 10th!

[Mikko’s New Legendary Skin: Sarvainai the Holy Beast]
Sarvainai is the fifth offspring of the dragon.
Warrior Saint of Mt. Pamir: Tong has summoned this awe-inspiring holy beast to repel the Silhouette of Nine Li and his army. Sarvainai, who wields the immense power of the scorching sun, is ready to bring a new dawn to the battlefield.
Mikko’s New Legendary Skin: Sarvainai the Holy Beast will be available on January 10th!

[Tong’s New Skin: Warrior Saint of Mt. Pamir]
It is believed that the Rain Dragon, the Mountain God of Mount Pamir, will bestow its power upon the individual with the most formidable martial skills and the purest heart, transforming them into the Warrior Saint and protector of Mount Pamir.
Underwent perilous trials and training, Tong has finally attained the divine power that enables her to transform into a Rain Dragon. From that day forward, she will be intimately bound to the sacred mountain, watching over the vast expanse of Cathay and sending timely breezes and precipitation to ensure the country's great prosperity.

[Thanatos’s New Skin: Silhouette of Nine Li]
In the far East, the leader of Nine Li controls his army with horrendous spells and charms. He ruthlessly sought to dominate the world and dip his hand in the Central Plains, leaving misery and suffering in his wake with thunder and lightning.
It is said that his colossal storm-summoning scythe is still unrivaled to this day. Let’s see if he can find an equal adversary beneath Mt. Pamir.

[New Skin for Cookie & Can: Evil Dr. Cookie]
Driven by element K, Dr. Cookie became increasingly paranoid and set his mind on solving the energy crisis of the metropolis through destruction.
Can the challengers defeat him and his RoboT-Rex VX-001, restoring his senses?

[Macalon’s New Legendary Skin: RoboT-Rex VX-001]
Dr. Cookie has created RoboT-Rex VX-001, a full-metal dragon with tremendous combat power, to wreak havoc on the Metropolis. Modeled after Macalon, the Metropolis' most powerful creature, the RoboT-Rex is armed with radioactive charged cannons full of Element K and a thruster on its back capable of causing catastrophic damage.
Maybe he can create some fun-sized toys after all the hassle; the kids are sure to love them!
Macalon’s New Legendary Skin: RoboT-Rex VX-001, will be available on January 21st!

[Hero Shop]
The Hero Shop is officially online! You can purchase Heroes from the Hero Shop using either Hero Coins or Lucky Coins and decide whom to unlock first.
Lucky Coins can be acquired through the Star Pass, Party Pass, and regular Events.

[Lab Mode Update: Party Royale]
BR Mode: Party Royale is coming to Lab Mode on January 10th, offering a 10-player survival match.
Players are dropped into a perilous jungle in “Party Royale.” You can look for Chests to uncover valuables that strengthen your fighting power, utilize different Map mechanisms to reach the match point circle, use the terrain to your advantage, and surprise your opponents with various items you have discovered.
Flash Party has become more approachable with the addition of BR Mode. With the abundance of Items in Party Royal, the game has been given more randomness and playability. With the new "Colorful Sticker" mechanism and our expansive Map, the Heroes are sure to astound us with their extraordinary performances.

[Adjustments]
________________________________________
Arena Adjustments
• New Rank: Master.
• The number of Arena Points needed to reach Master V Rank is 5900.
• The requirement for attaining the Diamond V Rank has been lowered to 4300 points from 4400.
• The Arena Points required for each Diamond Rank have been reduced.

Party Pass Adjustments
• A total of 688 Lucky Coins have been added to the Advanced Rewards of Star Card Unlock purchases.
• The amounts of Aura Chests and General Energies have increased for both the Basic and Advanced rewards.
• We have adjusted the methods of buying Star Card and Star Card Deluxe so that both are direct purchases.

Star Pass Adjustments
• Mikko has replaced Tina as the claimable Hero in Star Pass 15 now. Players with 15 or more Stars who do not have Mikko will receive the Hero automatically after the update.
• The Hero reward for 100 Stars and above has been replaced by the Hero Coin reward.
• Sticker Fragment reward has been added.

More Items in Alter Crystal Exchange Shop

• New KO Effect: Deep Sea Lullaby

• New Item: Optional Colorful Sticker Pack

Other New Events

• Other New Events - Party Host: Invite new and returning players to the party, the host, and the invitee will be rewarded with fantastic prizes!
• New Event - Piggy Bank: A Piggy Bank that appears by chance. Top it up for massive Lucky Coin rewards.
• New Event - Alter Verse Invasion: Randomly appearing Challenge Stages. Defeat AI-controlled enemies for fantastic rewards.
• New Event - Super Value Rebate: Recharge at the event and receive General Energy, Optional Colorful Sticker, and other fun gifts.

Additional Login Methods + Adjustments
• Login options that allow users to sign in with their Google, Apple, or Steam Accounts has been added across platforms.
• Guest Login has been removed from the PC Version. If you are still logging in as a guest, please bind your FP account to your TapTap Account as soon as possible.

Other Adjustments
• A Lobby animation showcase has been added for all Heroes; start a match or double-tap the character to view it.
• We have optimized the UI effects of Select Mode, Hero List, and Friendly Battle.
• We have improved the Hero Details page by adding videos demonstrating the Skills.
• Filtering has been added to Hero Banner.
• We have improved the chest icon and chest opening animation.
• We have updated Heroes Training Ground Contents to incorporate the new Battle Contents.
• We have added some Badges related to our new game content.

notes.title: [Flash Party] Update Maintenance Patch Notes - December 14th
Update Maintenance Patch Notes - December 12th
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43307144/37803139c179c3a278cc481caa924a293fbea9ec.jpg

Flash Party is scheduled to be under maintenance from 12th December 08:00 AM to 10:00 AM (UTC+8).

[New Content]

[Lab Mode - Phase III]
Heroes and Colorful Sticker Phase III arrives in the Lab Mode after the December 12th update!
Tarara, Lan, Derek, Mikko, Magician, and Thanatos has practiced some new Moves. They are ready to jump into the Lab Mode and show us what they’ve got!

[New Skin Set: Snow Reverie]
The annual Snow Festival is coming up, and Seaya decided to host a magical performance to celebrate this special occasion with everyone, with snow as the theme. She has even invited Cupid from the Cosmic Top 100 DJs as her accompanist. What kind of creativity will their collaboration spark?
Magician, the Ace Agent, has not been idle as well. He dressed in Santa fashion and sent gifts to every show audience.
The show is about to start! Her voice is an ethereal snowflake, and the song is a dreamy aurora. You can hear the heavenly duet from afar, overflowing with festivity spirits.
The Snow Reverie Skin Set will be released on December 20th!

[Snow Reverie Skin Set: Seaya - Song of Snow]
Seaya puts on the carefully chosen costume prepared by Tina and casts a spell of Atlantis quietly under the spotlights.
The stage has instantly turned into a reverie of snow. Seaya strolls out like a queen from her snowy palace, about to conquer the world with her beautiful voice one more time.
Seaya’s Legendary Skin: Song of Snow is making its debut on December 20th!

[Snow Reverie Skin Set: Cupid - Music Man]
Cupid has finally become Seaya’s special guest for her Winter Concert. It's said that he's going to try something different this time?
Dressed in a tuxedo, piano keyboard in hand, Cupid is going to get the audience hyped up with his magic and music again!

[Snow Reverie Skin Set: Magician - Gift Courier]
The Ace Agent will never miss a chance to promote his performers. Now, the Magician is in front of the venue, dressed in a Santa Costume, handing festival gifts to the guests —— Seaya’s peripheral goods, of course, but who wouldn’t want it?

[Adjustments]
Brand new post-battle interface
• Our new post-battle screen is live;
• Each Player's battle data can be viewed from the post-battle screen;
• Every player will receive a medal corresponding to their performance in the game.
Hero Badge
• Ten Streak Badge added for Heracles.

[Battle Adjustments]
Terms:
A: Attack
B: Special (Star Button)
N Attacks: An attack without any directional input
Forward Throw/Backward Throw: Throw forwards or backwards
Invincibility: Can be attacked but will not be affected by damage or negative effects
Recovery: Cannot be controlled or perform any other actions

[General Adjustment]
• We optimized Grab stability for all characters in response to any contingency.

[Sophia Adjustments]
"I shall walk with confidence every day! "
Objectives:
• Optimizing character controls.
Adjustments:
• "Dash Activation": Adjustments made to activation speed, optimizing the controls.
• "Turn Around & Dash Activation": Adjustments made to activation speed, optimizing the controls.
• "Charged Attack": We have reduced the dash displacement for Charged Attack.

[Mikko Adjustments]
"Mikko! (with a serious look)"
Objectives:
• Attack Detection has been optimized to be more synchronic with visual effects.
Adjustments:
• [Side Special]: The KO angle of rear hit detection has slightly increased.
• [Down Special Sticker]: The kicking position detection was adjusted to be more synchronic with visual effects.

[Magician Adjustments]
"I have yet another inspiration!"
Objectives:
• Enhancing visual feedback.
Adjustments:
• [Up Special]: Adding Trailing effects to express displacement trajectory.

[Thanatos Adjustments]
"Sure and steady to pass the trial. "
Objectives:
• To reduce unexpected attack instability.
Adjustments:
• [Grab]: Grabbing range slightly increased.
• [Aerial Attack]: Attacks toward the adjacent opponent are now more stable.
• [Aerial Up Attack]: Increase the stability of multi-stage attacks.
• [Down Special]: Attacks toward the adjacent opponent are now more stable.

[Lab Mode Adjustments]

[Normal Sticker Adjustments]
• The addition of 4 types of Yellow Stickers:
• Tenacity: Increase Defence against Neutral Attack (Lv.5 Sticker = +4%)
• Fortitude: Increase Defence against Skills (Lv.5 Sticker = +4%)
• Disciplined: Increase Defence against Charged Attack (Lv.5 Sticker = +2%)
• Adamant: Increase Defence against Grab & Throw (Lv.5 Sticker = +4%)

[Tina Adjustments]
"The voltage is too high! "
Objectives:
• A nerf to Flash Kicks' combo-ability.
Adjustments:
•
• For the Aerial Forward Attack after equipping the [Flash Kicks] Sticker, extend the Paralysis during the first phase; and shorten the Paralysis during the second phase.

[Kamiki Yuri Adjustments]
"I need to control the Animus better! "
Objectives:
• Rebalancing the performance of Sticker [The 4th Animus Sickle].
Adjustments:
• Decreasing the damage and knock-out power of a fully charged Side Special when [The 4th Animus Sickle] is equipped.

[Bug Fixes]
• Standard Mode:
• We have fixed the issue where Sivi's "Final Blow" effect wouldn't go away under certain circumstances.
• We have fixed the issue where Sivi - Speeding Racer's block is showing the wrong effect.
• Macalon's Side Special might trigger a Trade under certain circumstances, which it shouldn't. The issue is now fixed.
• We have fixed the issue where Macalon might go through the soft platform performing Grab & Throw.
• Lab Mode:
• We have fixed the issue where Tong's Up Special activates without special effects.
• The issue where Tong's Down Special still has the augmented special effects without equipping "Rub It In" is now fixed.
• We have fixed the issue where Sivi's fully charged diagonal punch wouldn't display the final blow close-up and Kill Effect while equipping "All-around Assault."
• Fixing the issue where Chilli couldn't summon Rust correctly while equipping "Rust's Double-Shot."
• Under Classic Input, Sivi's Aerial directional attack would sometimes turn into a directional Skill. The issue is now fixed.
• Miscellaneous Problems fixes:
• We have fixed the issue where Macalon's Side Special derivation Attack cannot contribute toward Spikes-related Badge Mission.
• We have fixed the issue where Thanatos' Aerial Down Attack cannot contribute toward Spikes-related Badge Mission.
• We have fixed the issue the chat channel cannot be used even after reaching 100 stars.
• We added a description for Skins that would have unique entrance animations. The skins affected are as follows:
